thread:
Nora: noticed mismatch in dashboard vs API errors again. dashboard shows 'Overloaded', but apps get 429s and sometimes 503s. customers confused.
Devon: yeah, saw a supportcase. we need a clear mapping doc so SDKs and console speak same language.
Ibrahim: proposal: canonical client-visible buckets = [rate_limit, capacity, transient]. map HTTP codes like: 429 -> rate_limit, 503 with route-fallback header -> capacity, 5xx without route header -> transient.
Priya: agree. also suggest we expose `x-rd-route-reason` and `x-rd-client-bucket` headers so clients can react programmatically. example: `x-rd-route-reason: capacity:fallback-quant` and `x-rd-client-bucket: capacity`.
Nora: good. what's the console badge wording? Ops wants short labels.
Devon: badges: 'Throttled' (rate_limit), 'Capacity' (capacity), 'Transient' (transient). show small explanation on hover.
Ibrahim: add this response example for SDK teams:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-rd-route-reason: capacity:fallback-to-quantized
x-rd-client-bucket: capacity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"request_id\": \"req_789\",
  \"error\": {
    \"code\": \"capacity_constrained\",
    \"message\": \"Routed to lower-tier model or rejected due to capacity\"
  },
  \"retry_after_seconds\": 45
}
```
Priya: about downgrade semantics: return 200 + `warnings` array when quality guarantee holds (downgrade-with-guarantee). otherwise 503 or 429 with explicit bucket header. SDKs should surface warnings to app developers but not treat 200 as error.
Devon: telemetry side: increment `requests.total` and also `requests.routed.capacity_fallback` when bucket=capacity. tag metrics with tenant, route_tier, model_variant, and region. store samples for console drilldown.
Nora: rollout UX idea: if any route shows >0.5% capacity in last 30m, show a yellow inline banner on the route page with sample curl and a link to the runbook. banner copy should call out "Capacity fallbacks detected" and include an example header.
Ibrahim: runbook snippet: include prompt-set difference check, guard thresholds: auto-rollback if quality regression >2% on guarded prompts or if capacity fallbacks exceed 5% sustained over 1h.
Priya: action items: I will update SDK error-handling guide; Devon will add badge copy and hover text to console; Ibrahim will add headers + telemetry counters; Nora will write rollout banner copy and add runbook link; ops-bot: please schedule staging deploy for these changes.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2024-08-02T04:00:00Z (simulated).
